verdict.rationale: Deepgram Voice Agent is a hosted, proprietary API/WebSocket service (wss://api.deepgram.com/v1/agent/converse) with no open-source runtime available; evidence only shows client SDKs, CLI, and starter templates that connect to Deepgram's cloud, not a self-hostable engine. No evidence of open-source runtime code, on-prem deployment, or self-hosting options exists in the pack.
